svg.text: What the improver is told — a field of the sealed plan
every level carries the run's own digest (calls, hooks, writes, the final text; no score) and the world's sources as counts; the levels add only what is listed

g.text: none
Harness²'s setting
the run alone; every task gets a session;
a judge model decides what to adopt
measured worse: fixed 1 of 3, adopted on
passing tasks too (finance-v14)
outcome
one bit, once
was the first encounter accepted?
accepted tasks get no session;
a judge still decides between tries
measured worse: the judge was wrong
on both tasks (finance-v15)
attempts
one bit per attempt — the test number
after every try: accepted or sent back;
the accepted try is adopted, no judge;
what real work gives: a request is
accepted or comes back, every time
finance-v18: 64% → 68%, 3 of 18 fixed, none lost
items
the bit plus the rejected items
per failed check: its kind and the object
it is about — a recipient, a channel, a row —
never the expected value;
what a reviewer's note says
finance-v20: 0/2 → 2/2; R built the
unread-sources hold and a tool by itself

svg.text: The grading row with its expected values stays on the host at every level. The trace store opens train sessions and the task's own runs, nothing else.
